subject: Re: Dedicated vs Private VPC — data isolation & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finsecure.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated vs Private VPC — data isolation follow-up

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Recap (call notes)
- Primary requirement: strict data isolation for sensitive customer PII and financial records.
- Must support customer-managed KMS (HSM preferred) and ensure keys never leave customer control.
- No multitenant inference on the same hosts handling FinSecure workloads (no noisy neighbors).
- Auditability: access logs, model inference logs, and admin activity logs must be exportable to your SIEM.
- Network: all egress must be controllable; ideally zero outbound internet egress for inference paths.
- Options discussed: Redwood Hosted API (no), Redwood Dedicated (isolated GPU pools + shared control plane), Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem package).

Clarifying questions: 
1) Do you require a fully air-gapped on-premise deployment, or is a Private VPC with customer-managed KMS + strict egress controls sufficient?
2) Will FinSecure manage KMS/HSM or would you want Redwood to integrate with your cloud KMS?
3) Any third-party data processors we should be aware of?
4) Expected throughput (reqs/sec) and model sizes (number of tokens / average prompt size)?
5) Timeline for procurement / POC (target deployment window)?

Proposed next steps: 
- Technical deep-dive with Mateo (solutions eng) to map network and key management constraints. I've attached a short deployment matrix that outlines tradeoffs across Hosted / Dedicated / Private.
- If needed, we can propose a scoped POC for Private VPC or on-prem evaluation.
- Please share preferred times for a 60-minute technical session next week.

Attachments: redwood-deployment-matrix.pdf

Thanks — 
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Date: 2027-03-11T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated vs Private VPC — data isolation & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the summary and for looping Rachel in. A few clarifications from our side: 

- FinSecure requires that customer data never co-reside on inference hosts with other customers. That means we're leaning strongly toward Private (VPC) or fully on-prem. Dedicated instances are acceptable only if they provide physical or strict hypervisor-level isolation with no shared inference processes.
- We control keys via our HSM (Thales); integration with a customer-managed KMS is a must.
- Data residency: all inference and related logs must remain in US-East region; no backups or logs allowed to leave region.
- Air-gapped on-prem is a scenario for specific regulated lines of business — we need to understand Redwood's on-prem packaging and support SLA if we go that route.
- Procurement: likely a 30–60 day RFP/approval window once we have a technical spec. POC could start in parallel if we have an NDA and scoping doc.

I've attached a high-level data flow that shows our ingestion points and third-party processors. Please review and a tech call sounds good. Second question: do you have a standard SOC2 + penetration test report we can share with our InfoSec team?

Attachment: FinSecure-data-flow.pdf

—
Alex Johnson
Director of Engineering, FinSecure
alex.johnson@finsecure.com | (212) 555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finsecure.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-12T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated vs Private VPC — data isolation & next steps

Alex — perfect, thanks for the details and the diagram. Looping in Mateo (solutions engineering) to schedule the technical deep-dive and to scope an on-prem vs Private VPC POC. 

High-level options we'll propose for the call: 
- Option A: Redwood Private (VPC) + customer-managed KMS (HSM integration) — isolates your workloads in a dedicated VPC, controls egress, supports log export to your SIEM. Shorter lead time (4–8 weeks to POC depending on networking approvals).
- Option B: On‑prem appliance / air‑gapped deployment — for the most restrictive lines of business. Multi-week deployment and install with our infra team; longer procurement and onsite scheduling (6–12+ weeks).
- Option C: Dedicated capacity in our datacenter with strict tenancy guarantees — possible if you accept our isolated GPU pool model plus contractual SLA and additional controls. This is a middle ground; we'll clarify the exact isolation guarantees in the tech call.

We have SOC2 Type II reports and recent pentest summaries that I can share under NDA. I'll bring a checklist for network/firewall requirements, KMS integration steps, and an initial SOW template to the call. 

Proposed times for the technical session (60–75 minutes):
- Thu 3/18 10:00–11:15am ET
- Mon 3/22 2:00–3:15pm ET
- Tue 3/23 11:00–12:15pm ET

If you can confirm preferred slot and the procurement lead for the RFP, we'll send a calendar invite and attach the SOC2 and deployment checklist.

Best —
